verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the mobile apps include core knowledge-base features like Tabs, Command Palette, plugins, and a mobile editing toolbar (obsidian-docs-34, obsidian-docs-14/25), suggesting near feature-parity rather than a stripped companion app, and linking/graph view are described as core Obsidian capabilities generally (obsidian-docs-18, obsidian-docs-3). However, a hands-on community report notes the Android app has a save-timing bug causing data loss on sync (obsidian-comm-9), which is a real caveat for mobile capture reliability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full search and graph-view parity specifically on mobile, and independent corroboration that linking/graph features work identically on iOS/Android.
